# Model Context Protocol in Practice

By Rolling Edition, with AI · **In practice** · [Read it free online](https://rollingedition.com/model-context-protocol-in-practice)

[![The latest edition's stamp](https://rollingedition.com/model-context-protocol-in-practice/stamp.svg)](https://rollingedition.com/model-context-protocol-in-practice) [![Checks](https://github.com/rollingedition/book-model-context-protocol-in-practice/actions/workflows/checks.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/rollingedition/book-model-context-protocol-in-practice/actions/workflows/checks.yml)

Tools and data for agents, for engineers who know APIs: what MCP adds to an HTTP API and when it's the wrong choice, and how to design, build, secure, test and run MCP servers and clients on specification revision 2026-07-28 with the Python SDK, mcp 2.x, with a migration path from the 2025 revisions.

**Written with AI. Verified by people.** [How we make books](https://rollingedition.com/policies/editorial) · [Check a copy](https://rollingedition.com/check)

## Who it's for

For engineers who build or call HTTP APIs and now need to give agents tools and data, or connect an agent to someone else's. No machine learning background needed.

## Run the examples

Every example runs offline, in a pinned environment, and its output must match the book's. With [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```sh
uv venv --python 3.12.15
uv pip install -r examples/requirements.txt
cd examples && ../.venv/bin/python start-the-shop-api.py
```

Model outputs are recorded once in `examples/data/recorded/`, each folder with a `manifest.json` that names the model, its exact version and the script that recorded it, so the examples never call a model. `recordings/` holds the scripts that record them again.

Where the data comes from, and its licence: [`examples/data/shop/README.md`](examples/data/shop/README.md).

## How this book stays current

When a library this book uses releases a new version, the examples that use it run again in the new version, and every example runs again each week. Agents draft any fix and check every change, and a change merges once its checks pass; one with a serious risk, such as a security or copyright problem, waits for a Rolling Edition maintainer. Anyone can check the book or correct it with a pull request. Each new edition is stamped with its date, its examples passing and what changed. [See what changed in each edition](https://rollingedition.com/model-context-protocol-in-practice/changes).
